snippet.title: Birdseed VR - Official Ver. 1.0 Release Window Trailer | Upload VR Showcase Winter 2025
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at Birdseed VR in this new trailer for the upcoming cozy VR game. Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature. Birdseed VR will be available on Meta Quest and Steam VR in March 2026.
